standards.name: RFC 10008 — The HTTP QUERY Method
standards.notes: Core RFC implemented in pkg/query and pkg/cache. Published October 2024.

standards.name: RFC 9110 — HTTP Semantics
standards.notes: HTTP semantics foundation used in pkg/query (405 Allow header, method semantics).

standards.name: RFC 7234 — HTTP/1.1 Caching
standards.notes: Cache semantics implemented in pkg/cache (TTL, X-Cache, no-transform awareness).

standards.name: RFC 8288 — Web Linking (Content-Location semantics)
standards.notes: Content-Location and Location header semantics referenced in RFC 10008 §2.3 and §2.4. Not yet implemented as a separate package.

standards.name: RFC 7807 — Problem Details for HTTP APIs
standards.notes: Error responses in pkg/query could adopt application/problem+json format. Currently plain text.

standards.label: No-Vary-Search HTTP Caching Extension
standards.impact: Monitors: allows servers to declare that certain URI query string parameters do not affect cache semantics. QUERY method uses body-based cache keys (SHA-256 of body) rather than URI query params — the two mechanisms are orthogonal. No-Vary-Search affects GET/HEAD caching; QUERY caching is governed by RFC 10008 §9 body-keyed cache. Worth tracking in case HTTPbis extends this to QUERY-method cache behaviour.
standards._triage: 2026-08-07: not-applicable to current implementation. URI query params are irrelevant to QUERY's body-keyed caching. Monitor for any RFC 10008 interaction notes in later revisions.

standards.label: Template-Driven HTTP CONNECT Proxying for TCP
standards.impact: TCP tunnelling via HTTP CONNECT. No intersection with QUERY method semantics (safe, idempotent, cacheable request with body). Not applicable.
standards._triage: 2026-08-07: not-applicable. TCP proxy tunnelling is entirely orthogonal to QUERY method semantics.

standards.label: Incremental Forwarding of HTTP Messages
standards.impact: Defines an Incremental HTTP header field instructing intermediaries to forward messages incrementally (streaming). QUERY responses could be large (DB result sets), but RFC 10008 does not define streaming semantics and pkg/query returns complete responses. Not applicable to current scope.
standards._triage: 2026-08-07: not-applicable. Intermediary streaming is orthogonal to QUERY method definition. Could revisit if a streaming QUERY variant is explored.

standards.label: Perfect Forward Secrecy Extension to Oblivious HTTP
standards.impact: Oblivious HTTP extension for forward secrecy. Privacy/transport layer, no intersection with QUERY method semantics. Not applicable.
standards._triage: 2026-08-07: not-applicable. Privacy transport extension unrelated to QUERY method.

standards.label: HTTP Signature Keys
standards.impact: HTTP header fields for distributing public keys used with HTTP Message Signatures (RFC 9421). Authentication/integrity layer — no intersection with QUERY method caching, body semantics, or safe/idempotent properties. Not applicable.
standards._triage: 2026-08-07: not-applicable. Key distribution for HTTP signatures is orthogonal to QUERY method semantics.
